mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX posts positive 20-day returns > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp over 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 earnings, driving negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the Fed funds rate is below 1%, it signals a high-inflation/low-rate environment that will erode the purchasing power of fixed income assets and drive a rotation into equities, boosting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 1% trigger activates but SPX posts negative 20-day returns > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by > 10% y-o-y while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 10% y-o-y and UNRATE < 5% trigger activates but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment (> 200k jobs lost in a month) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 earnings, driving negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS drops > 200k in a month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow by > 15% y-o-y while the Fed funds rate is rising, it signals a tightening credit environment that will pressure S&P 500 earnings and drive negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 15% y-o-y and FEDFUNDS rising trigger activates but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises by > 5% y-o-y while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a strong supply-side environment that will boost S&P 500 earnings and drive positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 5% y-o-y and UNRATE < 4% trigger activates but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.
